documents.source_note: ASS 26 (1893). Mechanical extraction of the historical printing from the Vatican OCR PDF reconstruction. A separately registered derivative restores most word spacing from the same native pages, preserving original glyphs and source order. Some native source letter spacing remains. Historical notes remain separate blocks at source-page breaks. Literal OCR errors and original hard-line hyphens remain; no lexical correction or original-print image collation.
